from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.adjustments import issue_credit_note
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

def inv(total="1000.00", status="issued"):
    return Invoice("inv_1","cus_1",lines=[LineItem("x",1,Decimal(total))],status=status)

i = inv()

# idempotency checked before state validation
i2 = inv(status="void")
r3 = issue_credit_note(i2, Decimal("10.00"), "goodwill", idempotency_key="k1")
assert r3 == r1

# approval threshold
i3 = inv()
assert issue_credit_note(i3, Decimal("500.00"), "ok")["amount"] == Decimal("500.00")
try:
    issue_credit_note(i3, Decimal("500.01"), "big")
    raise AssertionError("should require approval")

assert issue_credit_note(i3, Decimal("500.01"), "big", approved_by="mgr")["amount"] == Decimal("500.01")

# callers without key still work
assert issue_credit_note(inv(), Decimal("1.00"), "x")["amount"] == Decimal("1.00")
print("all edge cases OK")
EOF"}
